slot.brief: Give 2–3 complexes of the type [M(AA)_2X_2]; identify which show geometrical (cis/trans) or optical isomerism and count total isomers.

stem: For the octahedral complexes $[\text{Co}(en)_2\text{Cl}_2]^+$ and $[\text{Cr}(ox)_2(\text{NH}_3)_2]^-$, which statement is correct?
options: Each has 2 isomers; neither shows optical isomerism.
Each has 3 isomers; the cis form is optically active, while the trans form is not.
Each has 4 isomers; both cis and trans forms are optically active.
Each has 3 isomers; the trans form is optically active, while the cis form is not.

verdicts.working: Both are octahedral [M(AA)₂a₂] complexes. Each has cis and trans geometries; the cis form exists as a Δ/Λ enantiomeric pair and is optically active, while the trans form is achiral. Thus each has 3 isomers.

working:
For octahedral $[M(AA)_2X_2]$: trans is one achiral form; cis occurs as an enantiomeric pair. Total $=1+2=3$ isomers for each complex.
